transcription.name: Romaji
transcription.note: Hepburn romaji as Wiktionary prints it after the Japanese headword, inside the headword-tr span. The lang attribute keeps other languages' transliterations out, and the span strategy strips the link a romaji with its own entry is wrapped in. The article page is asked before the REST rendering, because the REST host rejects bursts with 429.

glyph.name: Kanji
glyph.note: The kanji of the headword, one transcription row under the scheme named here, and the language each character opens an entry in. No source is listed, because a Japanese headword already carries its kanji and the reading view drops the kana itself; the row exists so a kyūjitai form can be typed in by hand.

note: Language selector pack for Japanese. Pronunciation and audio sources are listed separately and can be added without changing the application.
